DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease).

The combination of a lacy, reticular rash on the trunk and extremities sparing the perioral area, along with recent viral prodromal symptoms like low-grade fever and rhinorrhea, is classic for Parvovirus B19 infection. The normal serology for Varicella-Zoster and Measles further supports this diagnosis.
